data.title: Lovesac: Buy Rating Reaffirmed as Solid Balance Sheet and Compelling Valuation Support $26 TipRanks Price Target Despite Near-Term Headwinds
data.description:

Tom Forte has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors that balance near-term headwinds with longer-term upside potential. data.title: Alliance Entertainment: Buy Rating Reaffirmed on Strong FY26 Performance and GTA VI Catalyst; $8 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
Tom Forte, an analyst from Maxim Group, reiterated the Buy rating on Alliance Entertainment Holding. The associated price target remains the same with $8.00.

Tom Forte has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Alliance Entertainment’s operational and market performance. He highlights that the company delivered revenue and adjusted EBITDA above expectations in F4Q26, supported by robust demand for physical media, particularly CDs and vinyl, and that similar trends drove solid full-year FY26 growth and margin improvement.

Tom Forte’s rating is based on his view that Alliance can fund its operations and growth without needing external capital, despite current leverage and weaker GAAP EPS. He also points to the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI release as a meaningful gaming catalyst for FY27 and the strategic vinyl tie-in, and supports his unchanged $8 price target through a 10‑year DCF, noting that the implied FY28 EV/EBITDA multiple remains attractive versus peers.

data.description:

Tate Sullivan has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, including stronger-than-expected revenue and time charter equivalent rates that reflect favorable shipping market dynamics. Despite higher drydocking and operating costs, the company’s earnings and book value per share are growing, supported by operational efficiency and fleet optimization.

Tate Sullivan’s rating is based on Imperial Petroleum’s robust balance sheet, highlighted by a sizable cash position, no debt, and value-creating capital actions such as share repurchases and a lucrative tanker sale.
